FiniteInformation.role: Finite classical joint information, processing and flagged decoder
FiniteInformation.assessment: Reviewed all declarations, marginals, mi, process and flag. log_sum and data_processing_fin are finite-array inequalities. flag_identity is the exact occupancy-weighted information identity; decoder_bound adds proper nonnegative normalised joint/channel data and 0<=pr<=1. necessary_radius_from_decoder uses that decoder and the Gaussian occupancy law to derive the radius, rather than inferring minimum spread from locality.
obligations: Include every permitted correlated input and establish the actual carrier/decoder correspondence. The compiled array information uses natural logarithms.

Fano.assessment: Reviewed all results and entW/condEnt definitions. max_entropy bounds entropy on a finite support. fano_single and fano use a finite message alphabet of size at least two and an actual deterministic decoder. required_information subtracts the error-flag entropy from the actual message entropy. The units are nats; the manuscript's bit version divides by ln 2.
obligations: The conditional initial-side-information and adaptive-history route is written in the paper derivation. Preserve that conditioning and unit conversion when connecting the finite compiled theorem.

RecoveryWork.role: Actual frontier integration and admitted-protocol lower bound
RecoveryWork.assessment: Reviewed all statements and the RecoveryProtocol/Succeeds definitions. frontier_work_bound permits real growth dimension d>=1, absolutely continuous nonnegative frontier, speed upper bound and charged positive area power; it does not require monotonicity. Wmin_lower_bound is a per-protocol bound. The infimum inheritance in prose is immediate but is not a native infimum definition in this module. Succeeds means radius reached; actual recovery fidelity is supplied by the carrier/decoder binding. The square completion and power asymptotic establish the stated late-age floor and divergence.
obligations: The physical protocol class must map to the admitted frontier/power structure; that mapping must establish rather than assume compulsory power.
G3 supplies a genuinely successful matching construction; radius reach alone is not its fidelity certificate.

GaussianTail.role: Gaussian occupancy tail and recovery-work composition
GaussianTail.assessment: Reviewed all results and carrierVar=2Dt. gaussian_lower_tail is an actual Gaussian probability bound at r<=mean. carrier_tail substitutes drift/diffusion parameters; necessary_radius_of_decoder combines a supplied decoder information requirement with the occupancy tail. x3_work_from_decoder composes the necessary radius with the admitted work protocol.
obligations: Actual drift, diffusion, complete payload/flag model and same-class work binding. The compiled implications retain their established gauntlet role.

AreaBridge.assessment: Reviewed all results. logdet_le_trace is a PSD-matrix theorem. channel_cap combines max-entropy/log-det, calibrated signal/noise trace and finite-range covariance bounds. required_traffic derives a uniform active fraction from positive deadline/capacity and an information deficit. area_power combines actual node count, activation and charged node power. The geometric or power quantities are not obtained from node count alone.
obligations: Connect the Gaussian results to hmaxent and the physical gain/conditional-noise/range bounds.
Use positive deficit and same-task deadline; a varying active set needs its service/concurrency accounting.

DataProcessing.assessment: Reviewed four results with mutualInfo=KL(J||J.fst product J.snd) and process as identity/Markov-kernel product. Marginal identities and KL contraction hold for finite J and actual Markov kernels; deterministic processing is a measurable special case.
obligations: This is a classical measurable-channel theorem. The quantum data-processing use is a separately stated mathematical route, not a new quantum formalisation by name.

GaussianKL.assessment: Reviewed all results. The likelihood-ratio formula and KL identity use nonzero variances. The quadratic moment identity supplies the finite second moment and mean shift. These establish the scalar Gaussian information building block.
obligations: Apply with the stated variance and measure conditions; this proves a distribution identity, not physical Gaussianity.

GoldenFormula.role: KL chain rule and mutual-information upper bound
GoldenFormula.assessment: Reviewed all results. Swap is an equality under a measurable equivalence. The golden formula decomposes KL against the input marginal times arbitrary output probability Q into output KL plus mutual information, with StandardBorel/nonempty input conditions. Nonnegative output KL yields the comparison bound.
obligations: The source joint law and comparison output measure must instantiate the actual channel.

GaussianChannel.assessment: Reviewed chan, quad, outVar and all results. The channel is an actual Gaussian Markov kernel centered at g*x. Nonzero noise variance and MemLp input provide the KL comparison against a Gaussian with output variance g^2 Var(X)+v. The resulting mutual-information bound is half the natural log of 1+SNR.
obligations: Finite second moment, actual gain and independent additive Gaussian noise model; conditional/adaptive application uses the paper's per-history binding.

KLAdditivity.assessment: Reviewed all results. Product kernels are conditionally product channels given the input; the associativity/swap laws keep that common input. KL additivity is for those product kernel constructions with Markov kernels and finite input measure, not an arbitrary unconditional independence assumption.
obligations: Use the actual conditional product model or the later whitening/correlated-noise theorem as appropriate.
